dropped: every position holds newChar where s had oldChar and the original character elsewhere (quantifier)
remarks: Refused on the conversion obligation of out[i] = newChar: newChar is a long on the interface and nothing bounds it to the range of char. A precondition CHAR_MIN <= newChar <= CHAR_MAX (the Char type of the parameter) would certify the unit; the protocol's list of allowed preconditions does not include it, so it was not added.
